summary: Castor Maritime Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the acquisition of a 2024-built Kamsarmax bulk carrier, M/V Magic Saturn, for $41.9 million from an unaffiliated third party, and the delivery of a previously announced 2023-built Kamsarmax, M/V Magic Jupiter, on June 29, 2026. Both acquisitions were funded with cash on hand. This is an ordinary-course vessel acquisition, not a transformative special situation. The filing is a routine press release for a foreign private issuer. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural details beyond cash funding are provided. What to watch: impact on fleet size and cash reserves; no risk-arb angle as it is a standard asset purchase.
